ticket.summary: Kitchen sink (both basins, disposal side included) draining very slowly for 2 weeks and worsening; no other fixtures affected, no leaks or odors - needs kitchen branch line snaked.
mitigation_advice: Avoid chemical drain cleaners until the tech arrives
If the garbage disposal jams, unplug it or switch off its breaker first and never put a hand inside; use tongs or the hex socket underneath [PB-07]
ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Tom - see you tomorrow morning! Booked: Mon Sep 1, 10:30 AM at 88 Larkspur St for kitchen drain snaking, $179 flat rate (~1 hour). Please clear out the space under the sink before we arrive if you can. If anything changes overnight - water backing up or leaking - text us and we'll adjust.
